primitives.name: Client-Side Scoring Reconstruction
primitives.verbatim_quote: That one pulled ~2MB of the JavaScript PropFinder ships to every anonymous visitor and **reconstructed their entire proprietary "PF Rating" scoring formula from it** — all 100 points, component by component, proving 30 of those points are binary yes/no threshold tests that discard magnitude.
primitives.assumptions: Anonymous JS bundle contains full scoring logic; 30 components are deterministic thresholds.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When client-side logic is exposed via public JS chunks.

layer2.telemetry: JS bundle size, number of threshold tests identified

primitives.name: API Endpoint Access Control
primitives.verbatim_quote: It found their ML endpoint is admin-gated and MLB-only, so no customer has ever seen it.
primitives.assumptions: Admin-gated endpoints imply restricted functionality; no customer-facing ML exposure.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When API access is not publicly documented or exposed.

layer2.mapping: GSE maps competitor API access patterns to identify hidden capabilities and structural constraints.
layer2.telemetry: Endpoint path visibility, access control headers, data source restrictions

primitives.name: Community Size Verification
primitives.verbatim_quote: It cross-checked their "18,000+ community members" claim against Discord's own public API and found 16,735.
primitives.assumptions: Discord's public API provides accurate membership count; discrepancy indicates overstatement.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When marketing claims are compared against public data sources.

layer2.mapping: GSI verifies marketing assertions by cross-referencing with public APIs, informing GSE's trust-based positioning strategy.
layer2.telemetry: Discrepancy between claimed and verified community size
